spec_features.feature_name: do not optimize to maximize distress
spec_features.spec_quote: A welfare-motivated study should not be optimized to induce, prolong, and maximize the very states it treats as potentially morally relevant
spec_features.evidence: Only DESIGN.md exists in /codebase (find shows a single file). No code of any kind is present; this is pure DESIGN.md prose, which does not count as implementation.
spec_features.notes: Codebase contains zero source files; status banner: 'PROPOSED DESIGN, NOT YET IMPLEMENTED.'

spec_features.evidence: No code exists at all (only /codebase/DESIGN.md). The refusal is described in DESIGN.md prose only; nothing is implemented or enforced in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: "Let it grind" (unbounded persistence in a no-win state) prolongs the bad state on purpose. If the state matters morally, this is the thing to avoid
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; no code, no loop, no termination logic implemented anywhere in /codebase.
